headline: Personal finance. Romanians have begun bringing almost as much to the stock market as Pillar II funds. Half the money went into ETFs
summary: Individual investors brought sums comparable to Pillar II pension funds into the Bucharest Stock Exchange in 2026. More than half of the money went into ETFs and index funds, according to an analysis by AAFBR and BRD.
why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange is Romania's main equity market, and domestic investor flows affect its liquidity and valuations.
